answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 12335 Country: India Title: As salam walekum, Please provide the details of number of rakats for all the five prayers along with details of number of farz, sunnat (maukada and gair maukada), nafil as per Hanafi fiqh. Question: As salam walekum, Please provide the details of number of rakats for all the five prayers along with details of number of farz, sunnat (maukada and gair maukada), nafil as per Hanafi fiqh. Answer ID: 12335 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 671/671=M/1430) The numbers of rak?ah of five times salah are as follows: Fajr: 2 Sunnah Muakkadah, 2 Fardh Zuhr: 4 Sunnah Muakkadah, 4 Fardh, 2 Sunnah Muakkadah, 2 Nafl Asr: 4 Sunnah Ghair Muakkadah, 4 Fardh Maghrib: 3 Fardh, 2 Sunnah Muakkadah Isha: Asr: 4 Sunnah Ghair Muakkadah, 4 Fardh, 2 Sunnah Muakkadah, 2 Nafl, 3 Witr, 2 Nafl Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
